1610e49a-60a7-49d0-8928-53b0b3316966.plaintext: A comment thread turns a page into a two-way exchange. Readers reply beneath the content itself, and everyone who visits sees the conversation alongside what prompted it — questions and the answers to them, corrections, additions from people who know the subject first-hand.
